sample_unit: LLM evaluations (58 protocols, control plus 33 identity variants, nine LLMs)
models_evaluated: nine large language models (names not reported in the text)

links.outcome: LLM trial eligibility and related-domain judgments across counterfactual sociodemographic label variants versus control
links.effect: Across 58 protocols and 5.3 million evaluations, eligibility judgments were largely stable across identities. Race and ethnicity had minimal effects after accounting for socioeconomic status. Homelessness produced the largest negative eligibility shift and pronounced effects in adherence, resources, and trust.
links.quote: Homelessness produced the largest negative eligibility shift and pronounced effects in adherence, resources, and trust.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLM bias across sociodemographic variants in clinical trial screening using simulated clinical vignettes, but it does not test a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
